best_match.fbbt_definition: Any adult neuron (FBbt:00047095) that has sensory dendrite in some chordotonal organ (FBbt:00005215).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00005222 'chordotonal neuron', a current FBbt cell term. FBbt has the adult-specific variant FBbt:00058257 'adult chordotonal neuron', which denotes the same cells in the adult; the data are from adult flies, so the adult term is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Sensory neuron of a chordotonal organ. The tip of its dendrite is associated with a rod-like structure called a scolopale rod.
